name: Ascension
audio: a soaring choral and string melody and the call of her bonded companion; no speech
world: The realm is alive: swirling frost, snowflakes and ice crystals stream and swirl through the air, feathers drift down and clouds sweep past.

actions.beat: {{She}} spreads {{her}} wings wide as {{her}} halo ignites, and Hoarfrost rises beside {{her}}.
{{She}} turns a calm, radiant look to the camera as the light and the feathers settle.

notes: The signature scene in motion: wings, element light and the bonded pet.
